meta.instrument: script/m14/incoming-gate.ts (single whole-population measurement; the declaration is DERIVED from its own TABLE 1 by script/m14/rust-declaration.ts, which refuses on any non-closure)

populationRule.rule: the admitted set is the GIT-TRACKED set: per-checkout `git ls-files` under $PWD/.corpus, extension .rs from the router's ONE table, present on disk, <= 1 MiB cap
populationRule.censusAgreement: script/m14/rust-extended-types-census.ts independently admitted 2532 files over 9 repos — the two instruments agree

meta.measurementForm: ONE arm run over the whole admitted population (2,532 files, single process, index=no — under the ~7,600-parse WASM abort point the dart lane measured, and the arm frees every tree). NO chunking, so there is no chunk-resolution bias and no mixed-index arm to caveat.

R1_qualified_and_foreign_targets.what: unresolved rows whose targets are qualified paths, foreign-crate leaves or file paths — a per-file analyzer's structural reach, stated rather than resolved. The census's per-construct counts are the evidence classes: derive args 11,176 (the mixes_in rows' targets are TRAIT names, resolved only when the file declares them), attribute names 16,195 (the decorates rows' targets are attribute names, not symbols), include paths 3 (the part_of target is a PATH by construction — §8: a fragment has no symbol).

falsifier.run: bun run script/m14/incoming-gate.ts rust rs 0 --dump (the whole-population arm; TABLE 1's per-type unresolved column is the count)
falsifier.wouldFail: a per-type unresolved count that exceeds the census's construct count for that type, or a resolved row whose target the project does not declare — the arbiter's key space is the project's symbols and the census counts the shapes

renders_corpus_unexercised.what: renders is IMPLEMENTED and CORPUS-UNEXERCISED (csharp's class — counted once inside implemented, never an exclusion): the census measured 0 render-macro invocations over all 2,532 files and the probe PROVED the shape parses (hasError:false, the tag identifiers are structural children of the macro's token_tree). The fixture rust/renders-component-tag pins the emission fires when the construct exists.

falsifier.run: bun script/m14/rust-extended-types-census.ts --json=<out> (the render_macro_invocations counter, whole population)
falsifier.wouldFail: a corpus file carrying a declared render macro (view!/html!/rsx!/render!/maud!/markup!) whose angle-tag identifier names a same-file callable or type — the census counts exactly that shape and the arm's renders row would leave 0

part_of_path_target_by_construction.what: part_of's 3 rows are UNRESOLVED BY CONSTRUCTION and their 3 extOK edges are project-CONFIRMED file claims: the target is the include! PATH because a fragment has no symbol (fleet §8), and the importProjectFile claim is statted before it is written, so the arbiter confirms the file exists rather than resolving a declaration. NOT `mod` (fleet ruling L-2026-10-21-06: ownership/split; the census counts the rejected near miss at mod_file_declarations 1,898 + mod_inline 227 for the record).

falsifier.wouldFail: an include_string_literal census count that differs from the arm's part_of edge count, or a mod file-declaration appearing as a part_of row

resolution_caveats: A CAUSE IS STATED, NOT RESOLVED: unresolved rows live in otherUnresolved, never in resolved, and the analyzer's scope is PER FILE with index=no — a target declared in another file of the project is genuinely out of its reach and the arbiter (which holds the project) is what answers it.
amb(kind) IS A SUBSET OF amb(decl), printed beside it and NEVER added to the closure.
collRes IS A SUBSET OF resolved (a tie-break pick among colliding declarations), printed beside it and NEVER added.

decorates' TARGETS ARE ATTRIBUTE NAMES, not symbols: the row's target is the attribute's own name (derive, tokio::main), so it resolves only when the file declares something of that name — the attributeKind split (builtin_directive 5,950 / applied_callable_candidate 10,245 by census) is published so a reader can discount the directive class.

mixes_in's TARGETS ARE DERIVED TRAIT NAMES: the census counts 11,176 derive args over 32 distinct traits and the arm counts 11,176 edges — EXACT agreement, the strongest form of the emission covering the construct. A derived trait resolves only when the file declares it, which a derive arg rarely does.
part_of's TARGET IS THE PATH BY CONSTRUCTION (§8: a fragment has no symbol) with a statted importProjectFile claim, so confirmed rows land extOK rather than silent-unresolved.

renders is IMPLEMENTED AND CORPUS-UNEXERCISED (0 sites over the whole population, probe-proved shape, fixture-pinned emission) — csharp's class, counted once inside implemented with the overlap printed, never an exclusion.
